note: Triennial election of the county council, 1911: polled Wednesday 31 May 1911 in six divisions; the other fifteen were returned unopposed. Byers was the sitting member; James Wilkin withdrew. No party labels printed. William Byers: no party label printed in 1911. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Markethill, 27 May 1908, printed 'U.': Northern Whig, 6 June 1908, p. 10 ("Provincial Elections: County Councils: Armagh"); candidates in the Newry Reporter, 2 May 1908, p. 10 ("Armagh County Council": the nominations); Markethill, 28 May 1914, listed as Unionist: Portadown News, 2 May 1914, p. 5 ("Local Government Elections: Armagh County Council"); Newry Reporter, 28 April 1914, p. 5 ("Armagh County Council: Nominations")).
